sources.title: Government of Odisha · Literature
sources.note: Ganeswar Mishra’s overview on the Government of Odisha website describes Sarala Das’s Mahabharata, medieval verse forms and performers carrying works to audiences. The passage here follows that account; it does not adopt the page’s broader origin claims or inconsistent dates elsewhere.

sources.title: Rebati — Odia text in Galpa Swalpa
sources.note: Fakir Mohan Senapati, Rebati in Galpa Swalpa: selected opening household and primer passages, read in the Odia Wikisource community transcription. These details belong to the fiction. The transcription has not been collated against a facsimile or a critical edition.

sources.title: CIIL · Odia Language, Literature and Culture: An Introduction
sources.note: CIIL catalogue record: 2019, edited by Sanjaya Kumar Bag, 222 pages, recorded language Odia and intended for non-native learners. The catalogue was inspected; the full book has not been reviewed.

sources.title: C-16: Population by mother tongue, Odisha — 2011
sources.note: Original Census 2011 C-16 workbook, Sheet1, row 101: individual Odia entry 015043, 31,507,158 people in Odisha. The wider ODIA group is row 96 and has a different total. District figures use the same individual entry. These are reported mother tongues in 2011, not current speaker counts.
